claim.claim-text: 1. A combinatorial drug delivery device for delivering a predetermined selection of drug components, each of the drug components being contained in a drug vial, the device comprising:

a housing having a discharge passageway, wherein a first of the modules is coupled to the housing with the second passageway of the first module being in communication with the discharge passageway, and, wherein a second of the modules is coupled to the first module with the second passageway of the second module being in communication with the first passageway of the first module, the first module being located between the second module and the housing; and, a source of negative pressure for drawing the drug components from the drug vials of the modules and into the discharge passageway.
2. A device as in claim 1, wherein each of the modules includes a vial retainer movably disposed on the body.
3. A device as in claim 2, wherein the vial retainer is hingedly mounted to the body.
4. A device as in claim 2, wherein the vial retainer is rotatably mounted to the body.
5. A device as in claim 2, wherein the vial retainer is translatable relative to the body.

6. A device as in claim 1, wherein each of the modules further comprises a venting passageway extending between, and in communication with, a vent opening formed on the exterior portion of the body and the first passageway.
7. A device as in claim 1, further comprising discharge tubing in communication with the discharge passageway.
8. A device as in claim 1, wherein the source of negative pressure is located inside the housing.
9. A device as in claim 1, wherein the source of negative pressure is located outside the housing.
10. A device as in claim 1, wherein the socket and the boss of adjacent coupled modules are configured to lock together.
11. A device as in claim 1, wherein the housing includes a controller for controlling the source of negative pressure.
12. A device as in claim 11, wherein the housing includes a power source for the source of negative pressure.
13. A device as in claim 1, wherein the source of negative pressure is a pump located inside of the housing, and wherein the housing includes a controller for controlling the pump.
14. A device as in claim 1, wherein, for each of the modules, the body is formed to wholly encase the accommodated drug vial.
